nodes.description: Private owner address stored in Ownable; governs the onlyOwner access control check.
Payable address that receives all forwarded and flushed Ether in EthForwarder.
Internal view returning msg.sender, used as the authority source for ownership and forwarding.
Internal view returning msg.data; no security-relevant state interaction.
Constructor assigning the deployer (msg.sender) as the initial _owner.
Public view exposing the current owner address.
onlyOwner function that sets _owner to address(0).
onlyOwner function transferring ownership to newOwner.
Sets destinationAddress to the deployer (msg.sender).
External payable function forwarding msg.value to destinationAddress via _send.
External unrestricted function sending the full contract balance to destinationAddress via _send.
onlyOwner setter that overwrites destinationAddress.
Internal helper performing a low-level value transfer and requiring success.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, forwarding events and destination initialization.
_to.call{value:_amount}("") low-level external call that forwards Ether to an arbitrary address and may invoke attacker fallback/receive code.
Parameter of transferOwnership holding the address that becomes the new owner.
Parameter of setDestinationAddress holding the new payable destination.
Parameter of _send holding the recipient of the low-level call.
Parameter of _send holding the wei amount forwarded in the low-level call.
Local variable in the Ownable constructor caching _msgSender() before assigning _owner.
Local boolean capturing the success flag of the low-level call in _send.

edges.reason: _msgSender returns the raw msg.sender value, propagating caller-controlled input.
Ownable constructor derives the initial owner from the caller via _msgSender().
EthForwarder constructor sets destinationAddress directly from msg.sender.
pay() uses msg.sender in the Forwarded event and is callable by anyone.
flush() uses msg.sender in the Flushed event and is callable by anyone.
The constructor local msgSender is assigned from _msgSender().
Local msgSender becomes the initial _owner, establishing the onlyOwner authority.
Constructor writes the deployer address into the _owner state variable.
Constructor writes msg.sender into destinationAddress, controlling where funds go.
owner() reads and returns the _owner state variable.
renounceOwnership reads _owner both for the onlyOwner gate and for the emitted event.
transferOwnership reads _owner for the onlyOwner gate and the OwnershipTransferred event.
renounceOwnership writes address(0) into the _owner state variable.
transferOwnership overwrites the _owner state variable with newOwner.
onlyOwner modifier on renounceOwnership compares _owner with _msgSender() before execution.
onlyOwner modifier on transferOwnership gates execution on _owner == _msgSender().
onlyOwner modifier on setDestinationAddress gates execution on _owner == _msgSender().
newOwner parameter is consumed by transferOwnership's zero-address check and assignment.
newOwner flows into the _owner state variable, changing privileged authority.
pay() reads destinationAddress and passes it to _send.
flush() reads destinationAddress and passes it to _send.
setDestinationAddress reads the current destinationAddress for the event and write.
setDestinationAddress writes _destination into the destinationAddress state variable.
_destination parameter is the value written by setDestinationAddress.
_destination parameter flows into the destinationAddress state variable controlling fund routing.
pay() invokes _send, entering the external-call code path while payable state is live.
flush() invokes _send, entering the external-call code path that can be re-entered.
pay() ultimately reaches the low-level value call that transfers Ether to the destination.
flush() ultimately reaches the low-level value call draining the contract balance.
_send executes the low-level call{value} external transfer to the destination address.
_to parameter is the recipient argument consumed by _send.
_amount parameter is the value argument consumed by _send.
_amount is forwarded as the call value in the low-level external call.
_to is the attacker-influenceable target of the low-level call, enabling malicious fallback execution.
The success flag of the external call is captured in the sent local variable.
require(sent) branches control flow on the outcome of the attacker-influenced external call.
An attacker fallback can re-enter flush() while the value transfer is executing, draining the balance repeatedly.
An attacker fallback can re-enter pay() during the external value transfer.
destinationAddress is supplied as the _to argument of _send, so a malicious destination can re-enter.

normalization_plan.reason: _destination is only a parameter of setDestinationAddress and should be normalized into that setter function.
_to is only a parameter of the internal _send helper and should be folded into it.
_amount is only a parameter of the internal _send helper and should be folded into it.
msgSender is a temporary local used only inside the Ownable constructor and should be merged into it.
sent is a local success flag used only inside _send for the require check and should be merged into it.
